en: An illustrated vintage postcard showing the rear of a steam locomotive with smoke at the bottom and a panoramic view of a town and surrounding hills framed within the back of the train. The upper part of the engine bears the printed words 'Buduća lička željeznica Otočac'. At the bottom there is cursive handwritten text, and in the lower left corner the name 'Josip B. Orešković.' appears.
